messages:
Nina: FYI noticed console dashboards showing token usage for org-B while the request headers were org-A. happened after a rapid org switch during a demo.
Carlos: can you drop a sanitized request/response? might be a batching/telemetry aggregation issue.
Nina: pasted (sanitized):
```
DEBUG prefetcher id=zz11 route=/console/widgets user=u-91 cookie=rb_sess=xyz X-Org=org-A
batch_id=batch-774 payload_keys=[user:u-91,session:xyz]
stored_meta={"org":"org-B","widgets_cache_v":2}
```
Ravi: hmm batch_id suggests the async batcher grouped a stale prefetch into a later batch where headers changed. our batcher keys are session+route, not org.
Marta: is this only UI attribution or does it hit billing/quotas?
Nina: billing pinged us, said two customers had a 30m spike. looks like backfill pipeline uses console telemetry as source-of-truth so wrong org -> wrong quota ledger entry.
Carlos: immediate mitigation ideas? toggle to include org in the telemetry event and add a conservative fallback rule in the backfill job: if event.org missing -> drop.
Ravi: dropping events without explicit org will reduce noise but could lose legit telemetry. better: make batcher attach the X-Org at enqueue time and record original_org in payload. then downstream uses original_org if present.
Marta: sounds ok. what's the rollout risk? this touches the async worker code used by mobile too.
Ravi: small change in worker to copy header into batch envelope. should be low risk but needs tight canary.
qa-bot: repro checklist:
1) user in org-A and org-B, enable rapid switch
2) trigger many prefetched widgets to force batching (QPS ~300)
3) assert stored_meta.org matches request X-Org for all final batches
4) simulate backfill and ensure ledger attribution uses stored_meta.original_org if present
Nina: plan proposal:
- short-term: add event-level org field in console telemetry emitter + drop-if-empty rule in backfill (feature flagged)
- mid-term: modify async batcher to attach enqueue_org and original_org into batch envelope
- long-term: consider per-org batch queues to avoid cross-org coalescing entirely
Carlos: also add metric "prefetch_org_discrepancy" and dashboard. fire an alert at 5/min per region.
Marta: include a feature flag flag:telemetry.prefetch_org_strict so we can roll back quickly. document in rollouts/console-howto.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary=prod-canary @ 1712227200, rollout window 30m.
Ravi: I'll draft the PR for the batcher change and include unit tests for envelope copy and a migration note.
Nina: I'll own monitoring during canary. will forward any billing noise to finance and create an incident if quota drift > 2% for a customer.
Carlos: create an issue for the billing backfill team to add defensive checks: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-1307
qa-bot: running e2e tag=org_switch_stress on every commit. report will be attached to the PR.
Marta: thanks, team. small rollback plan: flip flag off -> revert emitter, then rollback worker if needed. keep ops on standby. :thumbsup:
